name: iam-adty/empira-frankenphp
description: FrankenPHP worker mode for Empira, as a module. Optional: an application runs without it, under php-fpm, nginx or the built-in server.

extra.//branch-alias: Identical to every other library's, and dev/tools/module-contract checks that it stays identical: one manifest drifting to a different line is otherwise invisible until something resolves against it. No git tag is used, because a tag cannot move and would need a constraint bump and a re-lock in every consumer for each change. 0.x on its own would NOT have worked — Composer parses 0.1.0 as stable, so a 0.x tag would mark a release. See dev/planning/CHECKLIST.md §6.

//repositories: The framework is not on Packagist yet, so it resolves from its GitHub repository. A local path repository used to sit here so a sibling checkout resolved without the network; it does not survive a clone, which is what this replaces.
